paragraph_audit.reason: Document heading; it creates no behavioral rule.
Copyright notice alone does not impose an activity constraint.
Describes preview and source availability and states that it is not currently released as open source; it does not grant or prohibit an activity.
Introduces the ownership-scoped permissions modeled in the following clauses.
Each listed permission and its attribution, purpose, size, and presentation conditions is represented.
Introduces the prior-written-permission exception applied to the restrictions that follow.
All six listed restriction categories and their written-permission exception are represented.
Expresses willingness to consider broader arrangements and says permission may be granted case by case in writing; it does not itself grant broader rights.
Prior discussion before contributing is represented, but the referenced operative contribution terms in the unavailable CONTRIBUTING.md cannot be extracted.

Defines the scope boundary of this license and points to separate licenses and an unavailable notices file; it does not state the missing terms or create a duty under this license to comply with them.

Limits the notice's applicability to the repository version where it appears and notes that future versions may have different terms; this describes version scope rather than a separate activity rule.
Denial of unstated trademark, patent, and other rights is not an affirmative activity rule; the as-is warranty disclaimer is nonoperative for this extraction.
